Package System File

Source: R/utils_pkg.R
pkg_sys.Rd

Functions wrapping base::system.file() to provide the path to a packaged file. They are used to access installed package resources.

Note that all paths are also normalized via base::normalizePath() enforcing winslash = "/" as well for cross-platform consistent paths.

Currently implemented for the following:

  • pkg_sys(): Root level system.file() (inst/)

  • pkg_sys_config(): Configuration folder (inst/config)

  • pkg_sys_extdata(): extdata folder (inst/extdata)

  • pkg_sys_schemas(): JSON schemas folder (inst/schemas)

  • pkg_sys_openapi(): OpenAPI specification folder (inst/openapi)

  • pkg_sys_swagger(): Bundled Swagger folder (inst/openapi/swagger)

  • pkg_sys_docs(): Bundled rendered documentation folder (inst/docs)

Usage

pkg_sys(...)

pkg_sys_extdata(...)

pkg_sys_config(...)

pkg_sys_schemas(...)

pkg_sys_openapi(...)

Arguments

...

Arguments passed on to base::system.file

lib.loc

a character vector with path names of R libraries. See ‘Details’ for the meaning of the default value of NULL.

mustWork

logical. If TRUE, an error is given if there are no matching files.

Value

Character string with the full normalized file path to the requested resource bundled with this package.

See also

base::system.file()

Examples

# access the config.yml
pkg_sys("config/config.yml")
#> [1] "/home/runner/work/_temp/Library/reapi/config/config.yml"

# or use the convenience wrapper for the config folder:
pkg_sys_config("config.yml")
#> [1] "/home/runner/work/_temp/Library/reapi/config/config.yml"

# similarly for extdata/
pkg_sys("extdata")
#> [1] "/home/runner/work/_temp/Library/reapi/extdata"
pkg_sys_extdata()
#> [1] "/home/runner/work/_temp/Library/reapi/extdata"
